displayName: AI Governance Audit Chain（AI 留痕与门禁）
description: Give your AI an identity, an evidence trail, and a gate. Every task gets a registry entry (who, what, on what authority), every step leaves a verifiable record (what changed, where the proof is, how to recompute it), and every high-risk action must pass a gate first. Use for AI overreach, runaway agents, unsourced AI conclusions, automation needing human approval, audit trails, accountability chains, and prompt-injection defense. 「AI 改了我的文件，怎么查是谁改的？」「AI 自动帮我发邮件、发帖，怎么拦住？」「让 AI 干活，怎么留痕？」 装上它，AI 会先给自己立三条规矩：每个任务建籍（谁在干、干什么、依据什么）、每步操作留证（改了什么、证据在哪、怎么复算）、 关键动作设门禁（对外发送、删除覆盖、付款下单之前先过闸）。适用于 AI 越权操作、智能体乱来、AI 结论没标来源、 自动化流程要人工审批、合规审计要留痕、事后追责要证据链、提示词注入防范、AI 可靠性提升。

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
